event_description: User creates a new account (fires once per user on first profile creation).
User signs in with Google or email/password.
Visitor launches the shared demo account.
User creates a new trading pulse (trading account).
User logs a trade entry via the discipline evaluate API.
User submits the in-app contact form.
User saves their daily trading journal entry (server-side, authoritative write).
A trade triggers one or more discipline violations (server-side, authoritative).
Trader completes the reflection gate after a discipline lockout, recovering score points.
